gloss: second hand (of a clock or watch)

definitions.gloss: second hand (of a clock or watch)
definitions.explanation: The thin, fast-moving hand on a clock or watch that marks the seconds.

examples.japanese: {秒針|びょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
{秒針|びょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気|き}になる→気になる：03027_kininaru⟧。
examples.english: The ticking of the second hand bothers me.

examples.japanese: {試験中|しけんちゅう}、⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秒針|びょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: During the exam, only the sound of the clock's second hand advancing could be heard.

notes:
The slender hand that sweeps around a clock face once per minute, marking seconds. Often the source of a clock's audible ticking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秒針|びょうしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: the second hand advances
- {秒針|びょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧: the ticking of the second hand

RELATED WORDS:
- {長針|ちょうしん}: the minute hand
- {短針|たんしん}: the hour hand
